about: Lines KASE does not publish, read off NAC Kazatomprom's own audited IFRS statements. Every figure below is quoted from the document named in each entry; the check against KASE's published totals for the same period runs on import.

entries.document: Consolidated Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2023

notes.operating_profit: FY2023 results announcement, consolidated statement of profit or loss: https://www.kazatomprom.kz/en/media/view/finansovie_rezultati_ao_nak_kazatomprom_za_2023_god
notes.ebitda: Not a line the issuer reports. Operating profit 680,812 plus depreciation and amortisation charged to profit or loss 95,162 (note 20). Stored so the model adds back reported D&A instead of assuming none; it is not the issuer's 'adjusted EBITDA' of 828,623, which carries further adjustments.
notes.interest_expense: Note 15, finance costs: interest expense on loans and borrowings 3,753. Total finance costs of 9,589 also carry the unwinding of provisions, which is not a cost of debt.
notes.cash_and_equivalents: Note 29: total cash and cash equivalents 211,912 (2022: 169,536).
notes.total_debt: Note 31, reconciliation of debt: debt at 31 December 2023 of 86,377, being loans and borrowings 86,252 plus lease liabilities 125.
notes.capex: Note 5, segment information: capital expenditure 109,882 for 2023 (2022: 89,180), being additions to non-current assets. The 201,321 quoted in the results announcement is a 100%-basis mining-company measure, not the Group's consolidated spend.
notes.cross_check: The same note reports total assets 2,599,292 and total liabilities 591,025, which match what KASE published for this period.
